ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ الْمُخْتَصِّيْنَ بِحُسْنِ الْمَفَازِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Al-mukhtaṣṣīna bi ḥusni ‘l-mafāz.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family those chosen for the best of success!

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ طَيِّبِ الْأَنْفَاسِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Ṭayyibi ‘l-anfās.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family of perfumed breaths!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ وَابْسُطْ لَنَا الرِّزْقَ وَأَغْنِنَا عَنِ النَّاسِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa ‘bsuṭ lana ‘r-rizqa wa aghninā `ani ‘n-nās.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and expand our provision and suffice us from people!
